messages.subject: Executive Leadership Profile | GCC Energy Transition, ESG & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Daley,

I am reaching out directly following an earlier delivery failure to a general EXERGY address. Your current recruitment activity across power, utilities, infrastructure and asset-intensive businesses in the GCC makes EXERGY a strong fit for my executive profile.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My leadership remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement, executive advisory and country-facing coordination in a complex, regulated mining environment.

A central part of my current work sits at the intersection of major investment, government, regulators, communities and operating teams. I also support governance and external positioning around AGM's approximately 46-50 MWp solar platform and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, alongside carbon-accounting and broader sustainability work. This gives me direct exposure to the institutional, regulatory and stakeholder dimensions surrounding energy transition and large industrial operations.

I am interested in senior GCC mandates across External Affairs, Government Relations, ESG and Sustainability, Corporate Affairs, Strategic Partnerships, Stakeholder Strategy, Country Operations and related leadership functions. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with wider GCC mobility. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

I have attached my current GCC executive CV for your review. I would value consideration for mandates where senior stakeholder leadership, government interface, ESG, institutional coordination and country execution are central to business performance.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director | ESG | Corporate Affairs | Government Relations
